name: dev.papertype/papertype-mcp
title: PaperType
description: Render Markdown, HTML or invoice/certificate/report templates to PDF files via the PaperType API.

environmentVariables.name: PAPERTYPE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PaperType API key (dp_...). Get one at https://papertype.dev/signup.

environmentVariables.name: PAPERTYPE_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where rendered PDFs are saved. Default: the OS temp dir + /papertype.

environmentVariables.name: PAPERTYPE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin. Default https://papertype.dev; change only for test deployments.
